report.summary: A brute-force attack was detected targeting Institution_D's services, resulting in a high confidence alert.
report.impact: A brute-force attack repeatedly guesses passwords against services such as FTP and SSH, giving the attacker valid accounts and a foothold inside the network.
response_steps: Lock the targeted accounts and force a password reset
Review authentication logs for successful logins from that source
Enable multi-factor authentication on the exposed service

technique_details.name: Brute Force
technique_details.description: Adversaries may use brute force techniques to gain access to accounts when passwords are unknown or when password hashes are obtained.
technique_details.mitigations: Account Use Policies (M1036), Multi-factor Authentication (M1032), Password Policies (M1027), User Account Management (M1018)

technique_details.name: Password Guessing
technique_details.description: Adversaries with no prior knowledge of legitimate credentials within the system or environment may guess passwords to attempt access to accounts.
technique_details.mitigations: Account Use Policies (M1036), Multi-factor Authentication (M1032), Password Policies (M1027), Update Software (M1051)
